limitations: All failed and invalid episodes remain in denominators; no retries, replacements, truth edits, raw rewrites or provider reruns.
Five real heldout tasks share the same three repositories with development tasks; twelve synthetic pairs use tiny Rust/Python fixtures.

Graph exposure was broker CLI tools, not installed plugin callbacks, scheduling, task recommendation or bundled skill loading. Synthetic graph arm used one search among47 calls; real graph arm used2 sync and2 search among98 calls.
Unblinded source judgments are attributed evidence, not an independent blind audit; hashes bind content and do not authenticate reviewer identity.
Oracle false_positives include real out-of-set symbols and namespace formatting differences; counts22/20 are not fabricated-claim counts.
Provider input/output token totals observed for all40 episodes; cost and server weights revision unknown. No inference about billing or cost-effectiveness.
Real paired speed restricted to one both-correct pair; totals include cold setup and failures. No supported speedup/general effectiveness claim.

Canonical real scorer disallows effectiveness claims and does not meet preregistered follow-up eligibility. Final candidate repairs have behavioral validation, not new provider effectiveness evidence.
